implementation.targetScope: React 19 Slot/Root, Slottable and named factories; current property, event, ref, ARIA, render-prop and lazy-child contracts. No copied upstream runtime.

changes: Direct element slotting skips child traversal and intermediate arrays.
Only parent-supplied event handlers are scanned for composition; child props retain precedence.
Multiple Slottable targets and cyclic lazy child wrappers throw explicitly.
Ref ownership is handled by independently implemented vradix-react-compose-refs; React 19 is a peer.
Render-function declarations reject explicit element children paired with non-function renderers.
